svg.aria-label: Benchmarks against bitecs, becsy, miniplex and koota, in microseconds per operation (lower is better)
svg.title: Benchmarks against bitecs, becsy, miniplex and koota, in microseconds per operation (lower is better)
svg.desc: simple_iter (read and write every row): strata-ecs 11.2, bitecs 14.8, becsy 168, miniplex 94.6, koota 25.3. entity_cycle (create and destroy entities): strata-ecs 255, bitecs 257, becsy 400, miniplex 547, koota 1,533. spawn_reap_frame (spawn and destroy 5,000): strata-ecs 1,814, bitecs 3,157, becsy 4,703, miniplex 3,326, koota 10,356. add_remove (add, then remove a component): strata-ecs 484, bitecs 196, becsy 189, miniplex 886, koota 608. Measured on an Apple M1 Max with Node 24 and strata-ecs 0.5.1.
